description: This file defines the CatalogContext class, which inherits from Entity Framework's DbContext. It configures the data access layer for the application's catalog, basket, and order entities, including DbSet properties for each entity type and configuration setup.

classes.name: CatalogContext
classes.description: Entity Framework DbContext for accessing catalog, basket, and order data, registering DbSets for various entities and applying configuration mappings.

methods.name: CatalogContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DbContext with provided options.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Overrides the base method to apply entity configurations from the current assembly.
